thesis: The podcast explores how generative AI tools are reshaping online identity by enabling anyone to create digital influencers, ranging from net-new characters to representations of one's own likeness. While early predictions from 2020 suggested AI would eventually replace human models in e-commerce due to the repetitive nature of posing, the current explosion of technology has made this transformation suddenly tangible across fashion, advertising, and photography.
